blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.
blocks.zh: 以输入视频为条件的视频世界模型可以探索真实的,被记录的动态场景,使得能够重新拍摄镜头,自由取景重放,以及给被体现的代理商提供真实到图像的环境. 这种用途要求所生成的推出要忠于记录的世界,而现有的基准则从一个单一的图像或文字提示开始,视像条件的生成主要根据知觉质量和相机跟踪来评价。 这些评价没有直接评估勘探是否保留了主题特征、事件进展和地点一致性。 我们介绍万德·本奇 从视频中探索动态世界的基准 它由745个真实和AI生成内容的单镜头源视频组成,分为三个难度级(3-25 s),与作为键盘动作的相机路线对接,并评价了6个维度,其中24个为人验证的子度量. 以8个模型为基准,我们发现,随着剪辑时间的延长,模型保持了静态场景和视觉质量,但失去了相机控制和源动力学,没有哪个模型能够保持重温地点的一致性. 我们进一步提出"漫游地"(WanderLand),这是一个免费培训的框架,将被冻结的模型的每个框架条件都建立在同源的同源地上,并在重新审视时,以它自己较早的静态内容来进行. 摇摆 土地在每个维度上改进了5个模型,在源动力学的忠诚度上提高了8.3分.

blocks.en: Recent advances in video generation have steadily improved visual quality, motion realism, and temporal coherence, and the scope of the field has broadened beyond producing fixed-length clips to interactive world models, in which users continuously issue camera or action controls during generation to explore an unfolding visual world [ 20 , 17 , 40 , 47 , 49 , 8 , 14 , 57 ] . Such models offer new tools for game creation [ 22 , 48 , 5 , 36 , 2 , 68 , 14 , 57 ] , virtual production [ 38 , 50 , 35 , 34 , 53 ] , and robot policy learning [ 59 , 62 , 73 ] . However, most world models start from a single image or a text prompt, so the scene dynamics they produce are entirely imagined by the model and do not correspond to events that actually took place.
blocks.zh: 近期在视频生成方面的进步稳步地提高了视觉质量,运动现实主义,以及时间一致性,领域范围已经从制作固定长片段到互动世界模式,用户在视频生成过程中不断发布相机或动作控制来探索一个正在发展的视觉世界[20,17,40,47,49,8,14,57]. 这些模式为游戏创作[22,48,5,36,2,68,14,57],虚拟制作[38,50,35,34,53],机器人政策学习[59,62,73]提供了新的工具. 然而,大多数世界模型都从一个单一的图像或文本的快取开始,所以它们所产生的场景动态完全被模型所想象出,与实际所发生的事件并不对应.

blocks.en: Video-conditioned world models open up a new possibility: given a real recorded video of a dynamic scene, users can re-observe the scenes and events it captures along new camera trajectories [ 52 , 60 , 44 ] . This capability directly supports re-framing real footage and free-viewpoint replay, and offers a way to build simulation environments for embodied agents from real videos. Unlike exploration from a single image, these applications impose stricter requirements on the generated results: the model must not only synthesize plausible novel views but also remain faithful to the world recorded in the source video [ 1 , 65 ] .
blocks.zh: 带视频条件的世界模型开启了一种新的可能性:鉴于一个动态场景真实录制的视频,用户可以重新观察它所拍摄的场景和事件沿新的相机轨迹[52,60,44]. 这种能力直接支持再发真实的镜头和自由取景重放,并为从真实的视频中体现的代理构建模拟环境提供了一种方法. 与单一图像的探索不同,这些应用对生成的结果提出了更严格的要求:该模型不仅必须综合可信的新观点,而且还必须忠实于源视频所记录的世界[1,65].

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, it remains unclear whether current
models can faithfully explore the dynamic world captured
in a source video. Existing benchmarks evaluate visual
quality [ 18 , 69 ] , interactive control [ 58 , 64 , 27 ] , and world consistency [ 61 , 63 ] ,
including memory across revisits [ 12 , 71 ] . However, success on these dimensions does not necessarily
imply fidelity to the recorded event. A model may generate
realistic views and follow the requested camera trajectory
while altering the source action or its timing. It may
also produce seemingly consistent revisits by retaining
an outdated state of a dynamic subject.
This leaves a central question: can models use the source
video as evidence of an evolving world, preserving its
events under viewpoint changes, integrating information
across frames, and maintaining scene consistency during
revisits while respecting the event’s temporal progression?

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce WanderBench , a benchmark for evaluating video-conditioned world exploration. Each test case pairs a single-shot source video of a dynamic scene with a camera route specified by discrete keyboard actions, which determines how the events in the source video should be observed from changing viewpoints. WanderBench contains 745 source videos spanning real-world footage such as dance, film, and natural scenes, together with AI-generated videos in realistic, anime, and artistic styles, organized into three difficulty tiers from 3 to 25 seconds. We provide random exploration and out-and-back camera routes to examine continuous viewpoint changes and revisits to previously observed regions, respectively. The evaluation comprises 24 sub-metrics across six complementary dimensions. By incorporating source-video references, event timing, and visibility, WanderBench assesses whether stable scene structure and subject identities are preserved and whether dynamic content evolves in accordance with the source event, providing a systematic evaluation of faithful reproduction and sustained exploration of dynamic worlds under camera control.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了万德·本奇(Wander Bench),这是评估视频条件世界探索的基准. 每个测试案例将动态场景的单镜头源视频配对,并带有由离散键盘动作指定的相机路由,这决定了如何从改变观点中观察源视频中的事件. Wander Bench 包含745个源视频,涵盖舞蹈,电影,自然场景等真实世界的镜头,以及以现实,动漫,艺术风格制作的AI出品的视频,从3到25秒排列为三个难度级. 我们提供随机探索和出后相机路线,分别检查持续观点变化并重新审视以前观察到的区域。 评价包括24个次计量,涉及6个互补层面。 Wander Bench通过纳入源视频参考,事件时间和能见度,评估是否保持了稳定的场景结构和主题身份,以及动态内容是否根据源事件而演变,提供了对忠实再现的系统评价并持续地探索相机所控制的动态世界.

blocks.en: Benchmarking eight video-conditioned world models on WanderBench reveals two consistent failure modes. First, as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and their visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics: the output drifts from the commanded view and falls out of sync with the source events. Second, no model remembers what it has generated, so a revisited place is redrawn and changes appearance. Models limited to a few seconds of generation cannot even reach the longer tiers.
blocks.zh: 将8个视像条件世界模型以Wander Bench为基准,揭示出两种一致的失败模式. 首先,随着剪辑时间的延长,模型保持了静态场景及其视觉质量,但失去了相机控制和源动态:输出从被指令的视图漂移出并脱离了与源事件同步. 第二,没有模型能记住它所产生的东西,所以一个被重新审视的地方被重新绘制并改变外观. 限于几秒生成的模型甚至无法达到更长的层次.

blocks.en:
Beyond evaluation, we introduce WanderLand , a training-free
inference-time framework for video-conditioned world exploration.
WanderLand aims to preserve source-world identity and event progression
while maintaining consistency throughout camera-controlled exploration
and revisits. To this end, we develop
an evidence-ordered conditioning scheme that rebuilds only the camera and source render a model already reads: every frame is anchored to the source camera of the same instant and rendered from the same-instant source frame, and on revisits, the regions the source cannot cover are filled with the static content the model itself generated earlier. It
operates on pretrained video world models without updating their
parameters, using only each model’s own geometry. We evaluate WanderLand on WanderBench across
five video world models, demonstrating
consistent gains across all six dimensions, with the largest improvements in source-dynamics fidelity (up to + 8.3 +8.3 ) and dynamic revisit consistency (up to + 4.8 +4.8 ), the two dimensions targeted by the failure modes above.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: • We introduce WanderBench , a benchmark for world exploration from dynamic video inputs. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos organized into three difficulty tiers, with random camera exploration and long-horizon out-and-back revisit tasks across all tiers, providing a unified setting for evaluating exploration of source-video worlds from novel viewpoints. • We establish an evaluation framework comprising six complementary dimensions and 24 sub-metrics. By incorporating source-video references, event timing, and visibility, it systematically assesses stable properties that should persist and dynamic content that should evolve with the source event. Benchmarking eight models with it, we identify loss of camera control and source dynamics over long horizons, and inconsistent revisits, as shared failure modes. • We propose WanderLand , a training-free framework for enhancing existing video world models. Built upon these models, WanderLand uses evidence-ordered conditioning, which draws on the same-instant source and the model’s own earlier static content, to improve source-content preservation and dynamic-event reproduction. We evaluate it on WanderBench across five applicable models and observe gains on all six dimensions, most notably in source-dynamics fidelity and dynamic revisit consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: 我们介绍万德·本奇(Wander Bench),这是从动态视频输入来进行世界探索的基准. 它由745个单镜头源视频组成,分为3个难度级,随机相机探测和长视距出后复视任务跨出所有级别,为从新观点评价源视频世界探索提供了一个统一的环境。 我们建立了一个评价框架,包括六个互补层面和24个次计量。 通过纳入源视频参考、事件时间和能见度,它系统地评估了应当持续存在的稳定属性和随着源事件而变化的动态内容。 以8个模型作为基准,我们确定相机控制和源动力在长视野上的丧失,以及不一致的重新审视是共同的故障模式。 我们提出“漫游乐园”,这是加强现有视频世界模式的无培训框架。 万德兰基于这些模型,利用同源即时和模型自己早期的静态内容来进行证据定序调取,来改进源内容的保存和动态事件复制. 我们在万德·本奇上评价了5个适用模型,并观察了所有6个层面的进展,最显著的是源动力学的忠诚度和动态重温一致性。

blocks.en: We introduce WanderBench , a benchmark for world exploration from dynamic video inputs. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos organized into three difficulty tiers, with random camera exploration and long-horizon out-and-back revisit tasks across all tiers, providing a unified setting for evaluating exploration of source-video worlds from novel viewpoints.

blocks.en: We establish an evaluation framework comprising six complementary dimensions and 24 sub-metrics. By incorporating source-video references, event timing, and visibility, it systematically assesses stable properties that should persist and dynamic content that should evolve with the source event. Benchmarking eight models with it, we identify loss of camera control and source dynamics over long horizons, and inconsistent revisits, as shared failure modes.
blocks.zh: 我们建立了一个评价框架,包括六个互补层面和24个次计量。 通过纳入源视频参考、事件时间和能见度,它系统地评估了应当持续存在的稳定属性和随着源事件而变化的动态内容。 以8个模型作为基准,我们发现相机控制和源动力在长的地平线上的丧失,以及不一致的重新审视,是共同的故障模式。

Built upon these models, WanderLand uses evidence-ordered conditioning, which draws on the same-instant source and the model’s own earlier static content, to improve source-content preservation and dynamic-event reproduction. We evaluate it on WanderBench across five applicable models and observe gains on all six dimensions, most notably in source-dynamics fidelity and dynamic revisit consistency.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video World model
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频 世界模式

blocks.en: Early world models explored robotic manipulation and autonomous driving, including UniSim [ 62 ] , IRASim [ 73 ] , GAIA-1 [ 15 ] , and Vista [ 10 ] . With advances in video generation, world models can continuously generate subsequent frames from visual observations and user actions, enabling interactive exploration of generated environments. YUME [ 35 , 34 ] introduces natural language into world event control, while HY-World [ 51 ] and LingBot-World [ 39 ] explore world generation that combines real-time interaction with long-term consistency. Hunyuan-GameCraft [ 22 ] and Matrix-Game [ 68 , 14 , 57 ] support keyboard-and-mouse-driven interactive generation. AlayaWorld [ 49 ] further supports sustained world exploration through compressed temporal history and geometrically aligned spatial memory.
blocks.zh: 早期的世界模型探索了机器人操纵和自主驾驶,包括UniSim [62],IRASim [73],GAIA-1 [15],和Vista [10]. 随着视频生成的进步,世界模型可以从视觉观测和用户动作中不断生成后续帧,从而能够对生成的环境进行互动探索. YUME [35,34]将自然语言引入了世界事件控制,而HY-World [51]和LingBot-World [39]则探索将实时互动与长期一致性相结合的世界代. Hunyuan-GameCraft [22]和Matrix-Game [68,14,57] 支持键盘和-mouse驱动的互动生成. Alaya World [49] 进一步支持通过压缩时间历史和几何对齐的空间记忆持续进行世界探索.

blocks.en: Further work uses source videos as references for scene appearance and dynamic content, allowing users to re-observe the events they contain along new camera trajectories. ReCamMaster [ 1 ] jointly conditions on a source video and a target camera trajectory to generate novel views while preserving the source video’s appearance consistency and dynamic synchronization. WorldForge [ 45 , 46 ] improves trajectory-controlled video generation through reference-fusion correction and denoising guidance. InSpatio-World [ 52 ] supports spatiotemporal exploration through world states anchored to a reference video; Wonder [ 60 ] jointly designs visual camera control, sparse memory, and distillation strategies to support real-time world generation conditioned on images and videos; and World in World [ 44 ] converts source observations, target-view projections, and historical information into unified visual evidence, enabling training-free control through the pretrained model’s native self-attention. WanderBench addresses these requirements by systematically evaluating video world models’ ability to controllably explore dynamic worlds from source videos. Models must not only generate plausible novel views but also preserve the scene and subject identities in the source video, maintain the temporal progression of the original event, and remain consistent with the current event state when revisiting previously observed regions.
blocks.zh: 进一步的工作利用源视频作为场景外观和动态内容的参考,使用户可以沿着新的相机轨迹重新观察所包含的事件. ReCamMaster [1] 在源视频和目标相机轨迹上共同附加条件,以生成出新观点,同时保持源视频的外观一致性和动态同步. WorldForge [45,46]通过参考聚变校正和去诺化指导,改进了轨迹控制的视频生成. Inspatio-World [52] 支持通过基于参考视频的世界国家进行spatiental探索;Wonder [60] 联合设计了视觉相机控制,零星的内存和分馏策略,以支持以图像和视频为条件的实时世界生成;以及 World in World [44] 将源头观测,目标-视角预测和历史信息转换为统一的视觉证据,通过预先训练过的模型的本土自觉性,实现培训自由控制. Wander Bench通过系统地评估视频世界模型从源视频中可控地探索动态世界的能力来解决这些要求. 模型不仅必须产生可信的新观点,还必须在源视频中保留场景和主题身份,保持原始事件的时间进展,并在重新审视之前观察到的区域时与当前事件状态保持一致.

blocks.en: 2.2 World Models Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.2 世界模式评价

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks broadly fall into two categories: non-interactive video evaluation and world model evaluation. VBench [ 18 , 69 , 19 ] , EvalCrafter [ 29 ] , and VideoPhy [ 3 , 4 ] do not support action inputs or interaction, focusing primarily on video quality, text alignment, or physical commonsense. In contrast, WorldScore [ 7 ] evaluates camera-trajectory-conditioned generation, WorldModelBench [ 21 ] studies decision-oriented world-model quality, WorldArena [ 42 ] targets embodied agents in closed domains, MIND [ 63 ] probes closed-loop memory consistency, Omni-WorldBench [ 58 ] focuses on causal interaction, WorldLens [ 26 ] targets autonomous driving, and WorldMark [ 61 ] measures navigation consistency. WBench further introduces a multi-turn evaluation framework for open-domain interactive world models and R2M-Bench [ 12 ] evaluates consistency during long-horizon revisits in interactive video world models. Other efforts examine complementary aspects [ 13 , 30 , 11 , 6 , 55 , 31 , 37 , 66 , 67 , 48 , 72 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有基准大致分为两类:非互动视频评价和世界模式评价。 V Bench [18, 69, 19], EvalCrafter [29],和VideoPhy [3, 4] 不支持动作输入或互动,主要侧重于视频质量,文本对齐,或物理常识. 相形之下,WorldScore [7] 评估相机-弹射条件的一代,WorldModel Bench [21] 研究面向决策的世界-模型质量,WorldArena [42] 目标在封闭域中体现的物剂,MIND [63] 探测器闭-loop内存一致性,Omni-World Bench [58] 注重因果相互作用,WorldLens [26] 目标自主驱动,WorldMark [61] 测量导航一致性. W Bench还引入了开放域互动世界模型的多回合评价框架,R2M-Bench [12] 在互动视频世界模型中进行长视距重访时评价一致性. 其他工作审查互补方面[13、30、11、6、55、31、37、66、67、48、72]。

blocks.en: These studies provide a foundation for evaluating generation quality, interactive control, and world consistency. However, in video-conditioned settings, evaluation must also determine whether the generated results remain faithful to the dynamic world recorded in the source video: models should preserve scene and subject identities while reproducing the actions and temporal progression of the original event. WanderBench addresses this problem by incorporating source-video references, event timing, and visibility into 24 sub-metrics across six complementary dimensions, systematically evaluating source-world fidelity, source-dynamics fidelity, and consistency during exploration and revisits under camera control.
blocks.zh: 这些研究为评价发电质量、互动控制和世界一致性奠定了基础。 然而,在具有视频条件的环境下,评价还必须确定所产生的结果是否仍然忠实于源视频所记录的动态世界:模型应保留场景和主题身份,同时再现原始事件的动作和时间进展. Wander Bench通过将源视频参考、事件时间和能见度纳入24个次计量,涵盖6个互补维度,系统地评价源-世界忠诚度、源-动力忠诚度,以及在相机控制下进行探索和重新审视时的一致性,来解决这一问题。

blocks.en: 3 WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?
blocks.zh: 3"万德奔驰:世界模型能从视频探索动态世界吗?.

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Overview of WanderBench. (a) Data collection and curation.
(b) Six evaluation dimensions with 24 sub-metrics.
(c) Task setting: given a source video and action keys, a model re-renders the scene from novel viewpoints while staying synchronized with the source.
blocks.zh:
图1:万德奔驰概况. (a) 数据收集和目录。
(b) 6个评价维度,24个分计量。
(c)) 任务设置:给定一个源视频和动作键,一个模型在保持与源同步的同时,从新颖角度重新传递场景.

blocks.en:
Data Composition. WanderBench comprises 745 source videos, each a single continuous shot whose camera remains static or near-static, so that C ⁡ ( t ) = 𝐈 C(t)=\mathbf{I} denotes the original view.
329 are real-world or rendered videos collected from the Internet (Bilibili and YouTube), covering dance, film, daily life, stage performances, and other scenes; 116 are drawn from existing video datasets [ 16 , 24 , 41 ] ; and the remaining 300 are generated with MiniMax, spanning 13 realistic looks, 12 anime looks, and 48 artistic.
blocks.zh:
数据组成. Wander Bench由745个源视频组成,每个相机保持静态或接近静态的单个连续镜头,这样C = C(t) = I C(t) = mathbf{I}表示原始视图.
329是从互联网(Bilibili和YouTube)上收集的真实世界或制作的视频,涵盖舞蹈、电影、日常生活、舞台表演和其他场景;116取自现有的视频数据集[16、24、41];其余300由MiniMax制作,涵盖13个现实外观、12个外观和48个艺术外观。

blocks.en:
Clip Screening. Candidate clips are screened in two stages.
(1) Shot proposal. For Internet videos, static shots are automatically proposed by following Shi–Tomasi [ 43 ] corners with a pyramidal Lucas–Kanade [ 32 ] optical flow at 10 fps and fitting a RANSAC [ 9 ] similarity transform.
(2) Camera and dynamics verification. For each candidate, we reconstruct the camera trajectory with VGGT [ 56 ] , cross-checked with MegaSaM [ 25 ] , and discard clips with noticeable camera rotation or translation. We further check scene dynamics with RAFT [ 54 ] optical flow.
blocks.zh:
剪辑筛选. 候选人剪辑分两个阶段进行筛选。
(1) 射击建议。 对于互联网视频,静态镜头会自动地通过跟随Shi-Tomasi[43]角,以10英尺高的金字塔Lucas-Kanade [32]光学流出,并装入RANSAC[9]相似性变换.
(2)相机与动态核查. 对于每个候选人,我们用VGGT [56] 重建相机轨迹,与MegaSAM [25] 交叉检查,并丢弃相机旋转或翻译的相机片段. 我们进一步检查场景动态 与RAFT [54]光学流。

blocks.en:
Difficulty Tiers. WanderBench is organized into three tiers of increasing difficulty:
(1) Simple (451 clips) contains short clips with slow, mild subject motion;
(2) Medium (157 clips) features longer clips with higher visual quality and richer lighting variation;
and (3) Hard (137 clips) contains the longest clips, with the highest visual quality, large-amplitude subject motion, substantial background changes, and complex illumination.
Across the benchmark, camera-compensated motion extends from a median of 0.029 to 0.12 image diagonals, and MUSIQ imaging quality spans from 22.9 to 74.8.
To verify the single-shot filtering, four annotators independently labeled all 2,142 candidate clips as single-shot or not.
The annotators agree with each other at Fleiss’ κ = 0.93 \kappa=0.93 , yielding the final 745 clips.
blocks.zh:
困难的层次。 Wander Bench被组织成三个难度越来越大的层次:
(1) 简单(451个片段)包含有缓慢、轻度主题运动的短片段;
(2) 中等(157个片段)具有较长的片段,视觉质量较高,照明变化更丰富;
和(3)"硬"(137个片段)包含最长的片段,具有最高的视觉质量,大截面主题运动,实质性的背景变化,以及复杂的发光.
在整个基准中,相机补偿运动从0.029的中位数扩展至0.12图像对角数,而MUSIQ成像质量从22.9到74.8.
为了验证单发滤镜,四个注释员将所有2,142个候选片段独立地标为单发或不发.
在Fleiss = 0.93\kappa = 0.93)上, 注释者相互同意, 产生最后的745个剪辑.

blocks.en: 3.1 Evaluation Suite
blocks.zh: 3.1 评价套件

blocks.en:
WanderBench decomposes evaluation into six complementary dimensions comprising 24 sub-metrics, detailed in the Appendix.
Most of our metrics compare the output with a time-synchronized source reference: each output frame G ⁡ ( t ) G(t) and the source frame S ⁡ ( τ ⁡ ( t ) ) S(\tau(t)) depict the same instant from two viewpoints, so every frame has a reference without any temporal annotation.
All sub-metric scores are rescaled to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] .
blocks.zh:
Wander Bench 将评价分解为由24个子计量组成的6个互补维度,详见附录.
我们大多数的度量衡将输出与时间同步源引用相比较:每个输出框G Q (t) G (t) 和源框S Q (\ (t) S (\tau (t)) 从两个角度描述相同的瞬间,所以每个帧都有一个参考,没有任何时间注释.
所有分量分数被调整为 [0,100] [0,100].

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Visual Quality. We adopt \mtag [dQual]V.1 Aesthetic Quality, \mtag [dQual]V.2 Imaging Quality, \mtag [dQual]V.3 Temporal Flickering, and \mtag [dQual]V.4 Motion Smoothness from VBench [ 18 ] , together with \mtag [dQual]V.5 HPSv3 Preference [ 33 ] and \mtag [dQual]V.6 Visual Plausibility scored by the PAVRM model of WBench [ 64 ] . Since the task is to re-render an input video, all scores are normalized by those of the source video.
blocks.zh: * 屏蔽视觉质量。 我们采用\mtag [tual] V.1 美学质量,\mtag [tual] V.2 成像质量,\mtag [tual] V.3 Temperal Flickering,和\mtag [tual] V.4 从V Bench [18] 开始的运动平滑度,连同\mtag [dQual]V.5 HPSv3 偏好 [33]和\mtag [dqual]V.6 由W Bench的PAVRM模型所打出可视性分数 [64]. 由于任务是重发输入视频,所有分数都由出自源视频的分数正常化.

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Camera Control. \mtag [dCam]C.1 Synchronized Camera Following reconstructs the source and generated videos separately with VGGT [ 56 ] and compares the realized camera motion with the commanded one at one-second intervals.
blocks.zh: * 屏蔽相机控制器。 \mtag [dCam] C.1 同步相机 后续重建出源并用 VGGT [56] 单独生成视频,并以一秒间隔将已实现相机运动与被指令相机运动进行比较.

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Source-World Fidelity. \mtag [dWorld]W.1 Scene Adherence and \mtag [dWorld]W.2 Subject Adherence use a VLM and source subject tracks, respectively, to check whether the scene facts and subjects of the source are preserved. \mtag [dWorld]W.3 Synchronized View Fidelity reprojects the source frame of the same instant into the realized view and compares it with the output on co-visible regions.
blocks.zh: * 宣传来源-世界童贞。 \mtag [dWorld]W.1 场景遵守和\mtag [dWorld]W.2 主题遵守分别使用VLM和源主题轨迹,检查是否保留了场景事实和源对象. \ mtag [dWorld] W.3 同步 查看Fidelity将同一瞬间的源帧重新投影到已实现的视图中,并将其与可共知区域的输出进行比较.

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Source-Dynamics Fidelity. \mtag [dDyn]D.1 Motion Timeline Agreement compares the camera-compensated motion curves of each subject between the source and the output. \mtag [dDyn]D.2 Event Adherence localizes the source events in the output. \mtag [dDyn]D.3 Temporal Synchronization finds the best-matching source time for each output frame and measures the proportion that falls within a tolerance of the correct time.
blocks.zh: * 屏蔽源码动态。 \mtag [dDyn] D.1 运动时间线协议将每个主体的相机补偿运动曲线在源和输出之间进行比较. \ mtag [dDyn] D.2 事件 遵守将输出中的源事件本地化 。 \mtag [dDyn] D.3 时间同步为每个输出框找到最匹配的源时间,并测量在正确时间的容能范围内的比例.

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Spatiotemporal Consistency. \mtag [dCons]S.1 Subject Consistency and \mtag [dCons]S.2 Background Consistency penalize only the drift of subjects and static regions beyond the changes in the source. \mtag [dCons]S.3 Segment Continuity penalizes hard cuts absent from the source. \mtag [dCons]S.4 Static Geometric Consistency measures the reprojection consistency of static regions with Depth Anything 3 [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: * bullet Spatiotepolar一致性。 \mtag [dCons]S.1 主题一致性和\mtag [dCons]S.2 背景一致性只惩罚对象和静态区域在源变化以外的漂移. \mtag [dCons] S. 3 连续部分将惩罚源代码没有的硬切入。 \ mtag [dCons] S.4 静态几何 一致性衡量静态区域与"深度"Anything 3 [28]的再预测一致性.

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Dynamic Revisit Consistency. \mtag [dRev]R.1– \mtag [dRev]R.5 are based on DreamSim similarity (R.1), its pose-gated variant (R.2), place descriptors (R.3), geometric correspondence (R.4), and object appearance (R.5), respectively. \mtag [dRev]R.6 Object Semantic Persistence checks the objects that should appear in the source at the return time. \mtag [dRev]R.7 Revisit Event Currency measures whether the returning view shows the current state of a dynamic subject.
blocks.zh: * 弹出动态重访一致性。 \mtag [dRev]R.1–\mtag [dRev]R.5 分别以 DreamSim 相似性(R 1),其姿势定型变体(R.2),地标(R.3),几何对应(R.4)和物体外观(R.5)为基础. \mtag [dRev] R.6 对象语义 持久性检查返回时来源中应当出现的物体. \mtag [dRev] R.7 重访事件货币度量返回视图是否显示动态主题的当前状态.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluated Models and Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价的模式和议定书

blocks.en: Table 2: Results on WanderBench by difficulty tier. Overall is the equal-weight mean of the six dimensions. Bold marks the best score within each tier. Rows of the same model share a colour; grey rows are frame-limited models, which are evaluated only on Simple and only on the frames they can generate.
blocks.zh: 表2:按难度等级分列的云德奔驰的结果。 总的来说,是六个维度的等重平均值。 粗体标出每个等级内最好的分数. 同一型号的行共享一色;灰色行是框架有限的型号,这些型号只在Simple上评价,并只在它们能生成的相框上评价.

blocks.en: 4.2 Findings
blocks.zh: 4.2 调查结果

blocks.en: (1) Visual quality hides exploration failures. From Simple to Hard, the three full-length models lose little in Visual Quality and Spatiotemporal Consistency. Over the same range, they lose much more in Camera Control, Source-Dynamics Fidelity, and Dynamic Revisit Consistency. A rollout can therefore look clean and stable while following neither the command nor the source events, which per-frame quality metrics alone would not reveal.
blocks.zh: (1)视觉质量掩盖了探索失败. 从简单到硬,三个全长的模型在视觉质量和spatiotemporal一致性方面损失很少. 在同一范围内,它们在相机控制、源代码Fidelity和动态重访一致性方面损失更多。 因此,推出可以看起来干净而稳定,同时既不能跟踪指令,也不能跟踪源事件,而仅凭框架质量衡量标准是无法揭示的。

blocks.en: (2) Models keep the static world but lose the dynamic one. Source-World Fidelity is the highest-scoring dimension on every tier, so scenes and subjects are largely preserved. Source-Dynamics Fidelity, in contrast, falls to 37.2 on Hard, meaning the models keep what is in the scene but not when things happen in it.
blocks.zh: (2)模型保持静态世界但失去动态世界. Source-World Fieldity是每一层评分最高的维度,因此场景和主题基本保存. 源代码Fidelity,相对而言,在"硬"(Hard)上降为37.2,意思是模型保留了场景中的东西,但当事情发生时却不保留.

blocks.en: (3) Visual quality and camera control trade off. Across the eight models on Simple, Visual Quality and Camera Control are negatively correlated. WorldForge has the highest Visual Quality but only 44.8 in Camera Control, while UniWorld-View has the best Camera Control and the lowest Visual Quality. Faithfully executing a camera move appears to cost image quality in current models, and ranking them by quality alone favors models that move the camera less.
blocks.zh: (3)视觉质量和相机控制互换. 关于简单、视觉质量和相机控制的8个模型是消极关联的。 WorldForge拥有最高的视觉质量,但在相机控制中只有44.8个,而UniWorld-View拥有最优秀的相机控制与最低的视觉质量. 忠实地执行相机动作似乎在目前的模型中会花费图像质量,仅通过质量来排序它们有利于移动相机较少的模型.

blocks.en: (4) Short horizons hide the differences that long horizons reveal. On Simple, the frame-limited UniWorld-View obtains the highest overall score, and the overall scores of the full-length models span only 4.3 points. On Hard, this span widens to 13.5 points, and WorldForge collapses to 10.4 in Camera Control. Their strong short-horizon scores do not show whether they can explore.
blocks.zh: (4)短地平线掩盖了长地平线所揭示出的差异. 在"简单"上,受帧限制的UniWorld-View获得了最高的总分,而全长模型的总分只跨出4.3分. 在"硬"(Hard)上,这个跨度被拓宽到13.5分,而"相机控制"中"WorldForge"倒塌到10.4分. 他们强大的短视分数并不能显示他们是否能够探索.

blocks.en: (5) Model hardly remembers what it has generated. Dynamic Revisit Consistency is the weakest dimension overall: no model exceeds 68.6, the full-length models stay between 50.0 and 54.5 even on Simple, and WorldForge drops to 20.5 on Hard. Across models, Dynamic Revisit Consistency correlates with Camera Control, which suggests that a model must first reach the revisit pose before consistency there can be achieved.
blocks.zh: (5) 模型几乎不记得它产生了什么。 动态重访一致性是整体上最弱的维度:无型号超过68.6,全长型号即使在Simple上也停留在50.0至54.5之间,而WorldForge在Hard上则下降至20.5. 在各种模型中,动态重访一致性与相机控制相关,这表明一个模型必须首先到达重访时才能实现一致性。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Qualitative results on WanderBench. Each block shows one source clip (left tag: data category). Time runs from left to right; the keys above each column are the camera actions held since the previous column, and H denotes hold. The first row of each block is the source video at the same instant, followed by the outputs of each model. Grey cells mark frames beyond a model’s generation length, and the red dashed line marks where its frame limit is reached.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 关于万德本奇的定性结果. 每个块显示一个源剪辑(左标签:数据类别). 时间从左到右;每列上方的键是自上列起所持相机动作,而H表示持有. 每个块的第一行是同一瞬间出自源视频,后是每个模型的输出. 灰细胞标记框架超过模型的生成长度,红色破折线标记达到其框架极限。

blocks.en: 5 WanderLand: A Training-Free Enhancement of Exploration in Video World Models
blocks.zh: 5 " 漫游地:对视频世界模式的探索进行免费培训 "

blocks.en: To explore how source-video evidence can help address the failure modes identified by WanderBench, we introduce WanderLand, a training-free enhancement for existing video world models. WanderLand constructs conditioning inputs by prioritizing time-aligned source observations and using previously generated static content to fill regions not covered by the source.
blocks.zh: 为了探索来源-视频证据如何能帮助解决由万德·本奇确定的故障模式,我们引入了万德Land,这是对现有视频世界模型的免费培训增强. 摇摆 土地构造通过优先安排时间相通源观测,并利用以前产生的静态内容来填补源未覆盖的区域,对投入进行条件化.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Overview of WanderLand. WanderLand wraps a frozen video world model and leaves its weights, sampler, and seed unchanged. It only rebuilds the camera and source render the model already takes as input, taking evidence for every frame in a fixed order (top): the latent source first, then previous frames, and generation only where neither exists.
All geometry comes from the model’s own front-end. The frozen model then generates the output rollout.
blocks.zh:
图3:万德兰概览. 摇摆 陆地包裹了被冷冻的视频世界模型,并留下了它的重量,采样器,和种子不变. 它只重建相机和源头,使模型已经作为输入而取出,以固定顺序(上)为每个帧取出证据:先是潜入源,后是上个帧,只有在两者均不存在的情况下才能生成.
所有几何都出自模型自己的前端. 被冻结的模型然后生成输出展开.

blocks.en: 5.1 Methods
blocks.zh: 5.1 方法

blocks.en: For each output frame, WanderLand takes evidence in a fixed order, in three steps.
blocks.zh: 对于每个输出框,万德兰按固定顺序取出证据,分出三个步骤.

blocks.en: (1) Synchronized camera. The model’s own geometry front-end estimates the depth and camera of every source frame, and the commanded camera is then placed relative to the source camera of the same instant rather than to that of the first frame.
blocks.zh: (1)同步相机. 该模型自己的几何前端估计出每个源帧的深度和相机,然后将所指令相机相对于同一即时的源相机而不是第一个相机相机放置.

blocks.en: (2) Same-instant source. The model’s own point-cloud renderer warps the source frame of the same instant into this camera. As a result, the render covers more of the view, and moving subjects appear at the correct time.
blocks.zh: (2)同源即来. 模型本身的点-云渲染器将同一瞬间的源相框向相机中扭曲. 因此,渲染物覆盖了更多的观点,移动主体在正确的时间出现.

blocks.en: (3) Static memory. When the camera returns to a place shown earlier, we lift the model’s nearest earlier outputs to 3D points using Depth Anything 3 [ 28 ] depth aligned to the render depth, and use them to fill the regions the source video cannot cover. Pixels whose source content changes over time, measured by a camera-compensated color difference, are discarded. Moving subjects are therefore never frozen, and all visible motion still comes from the source video.
blocks.zh: (3)静态记忆. 当相机返回到先前显示的地方时,我们利用深度 Anything 3 [28] 深度与渲染深度对齐,将模型最近的早期输出提升到3D点,并利用它们填充源视频无法覆盖的区域. 用相机补偿的颜色差异测量的源内容随时间变化的像素被丢弃. 因此移动对象从不被冻结,所有可见的运动仍然来自源视频.

blocks.en: 5.2 Properties
blocks.zh: 5.2 属性

blocks.en: WanderLand requires no training and introduces no additional weights. It relies only on the model’s own geometry module and renderer and never uses WanderBench’s evaluation tools. Wherever the evidence does not change, it reproduces the original output exactly, and its only extra cost is one additional generation when the camera revisits a place.
blocks.zh: 漫游地不需要训练,也不引入附加重量. 它只依靠模型本身的几何模块和渲染器,从未使用过万德·本奇的评价工具. 只要证据没有改变,它就确切地复制了原来的输出,它唯一的额外成本是在相机重访一地时再增加一代.

blocks.en: 5.3 WanderLand Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 漫游土地结果

blocks.en: Table 3: Change brought by WanderLand on each dimension (score with WanderLand minus score without). World-in-World and WorldForge are not evaluated, since both are themselves training-free frameworks built on pretrained world models.
blocks.zh: 表3:万德兰在每个维度上带来的变化(分数为万德兰减去分数,没有分数). 世界上的世界和世界森林没有受到评价,因为两者本身都是建立在预先训练过的世界模式上的无培训框架。

blocks.en: We apply WanderLand to five video world models and report the change on each dimension in Tab. 3 . World-in-World and WorldForge are not included, since both are themselves training-free frameworks built on pretrained world models and do not expose the inputs that WanderLand rebuilds.
blocks.zh: 我们把万德兰德应用到五个视频世界模型中,并在"Tab"中报告每个维度的变化. 3. 世界与世界 福热不包括在内,因为两者本身都是建立在经过预先培训的世界模式基础上的无培训框架,并不暴露万德兰重建的投入.

blocks.en: (1) Consistent gains without trade-offs. WanderLand improves most backbone on every dimension and degrades none, so the better conditioning comes at no cost to visual quality or camera control.
blocks.zh: (1) 持续收益而无取舍。 摇摆 土地改善每个维度上的大部分骨干,而无一被降解,因此更好的条件不惜任何代价来达到视觉质量或相机控制.

blocks.en: (2) Revisits benefit on every model. Dynamic Revisit Consistency rises by 2.4–4.8 points across all five backbones, as the holes at a revisit are filled with content the model has already shown instead of being redrawn.
blocks.zh: (2) 查阅对每个模型都有好处。 动态重访一致性在所有5个主干线上上升了2.4–4.8分,因为重访时的洞已经充满了内容,模型已经显示,而不是被重新绘制.

blocks.en: (3) Long horizons benefit the most. The largest single gain is on the full-length InSpatio-World 1.5, whose Source-Dynamics Fidelity rises by 8.3 points: over long rollouts, anchoring every frame to the source at the same instant keeps the generated events in sync with the recorded ones.
blocks.zh: (3) 长远效益最大。 最大的单一收益是在全长的Inspatio-World 1.5上,其Source-Dynamics Fidelity上升了8.3分:在长时间推出后,将每个帧都固定在源上,在同一瞬间使所生成的事件与所记录的事件同步.

每列显示一帧每秒,上方的键是前一秒时所持相机动作.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
WanderBench moves video world model evaluation from a single view to time-aligned multiple views: each explored trajectory is a new view of the same dynamic scene, synchronized with the source.
We expect models that do well here to produce time-aligned multi-view videos from a single input, which could enable end-to-end generation of full-scene 4D Gaussian Splatting from one video.
Current models still fall short on temporal synchronization and long-range revisits, and we hope WanderBench offers a concrete target for closing this gap.
blocks.zh:
Wander Bench将视频世界模型评价从单一视角移动到时间相匹配的多视角:每个被探索的轨迹是同一动态场景的新视角,与出处同步.
我们期望在这里做得很好的模型从单一的输入中产生时间相通的多景视频,这可以使端到端生成从一个视频中产生的全景4D高斯平板.
目前的模式在时间同步和远程再访方面仍然不足,我们希望万德·本奇为缩小这一差距提供一个具体目标.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video, with 745 single-shot source videos in three difficulty tiers and 24 sub-metrics over six dimensions. Current world models preserve static scenes and visual quality but lose camera control, source dynamics, and revisit consistency over longer horizons. Our training-free WanderLand improves five models by conditioning each frame on the same-instant source and the model’s own earlier content, though it requires camera and source-render inputs. We hope WanderBench drives world models that stay faithful to the recorded world as they explore it.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了"万德本奇"(Wander Bench),这是从视频中探索动态世界的基准,其中有745个单镜头源视频分三个难度分级,24个子度量分6个维. 当前的世界模型保存了静态场景和视觉质量,但失去了相机控制,源动力学,并在更长的地平线上重新审视一致性. 我们免费的WanderLand通过在同一个即时源上对每个帧和模型自己早期的内容进行调节来改进五个模型,尽管它需要相机和源头输入. 我们希望万德·本奇能推动那些在探索世界时忠于记录世界的世界模型.
